checks.title: Evaluate lifecycle control discoverability
checks.instructions: After automated QA passes, switch OFF, SLEEP and ACTIVE from the main HUD, then trigger ACTIVE via C-wake and return to SLEEP through inactivity. Confirm the button is easy to find and its visual state always matches reality.
checks.expected: OFF feels clearly inactive, SLEEP feels normally armed, ACTIVE is distinctly but subtly brighter/electric-blue, and no state looks stale.
